long_biography.plain_text:
David William McAuliffe's documented business career centres on C&D Recycling, which operated a construction and demolition waste facility at Lara near Geelong. The site began operating under a temporary planning permit and accumulated a large stockpile while McAuliffe directed the company.

After prolonged disputes over permit compliance and fire-safety controls, C&D Recycling entered liquidation in 2018. McAuliffe was declared bankrupt the same year. He pleaded guilty to breaching enforcement orders; on appeal, a three-month custodial sentence was replaced with a community correction order and fine. McAuliffe died in February 2020, before separate environmental charges reached a plea hearing.
